raw.rationale: RU-58841 is a potent androgen receptor antagonist, so selective killing is expected mainly in AR-dependent lineages such as prostate, but prostate is not among the listed lineages; among the listed lineages, breast and urinary tract have some AR dependence, while most others lack AR-driven survival at 2.5 µM. Published PRISM-type screens show AR antagonists rarely produce lineage-selective viability effects outside prostate, so probabilities are low and near base rates.
